newsitem.title: USA: London Int'l unit plans condom promotion.
newsitem.headline: London Int'l unit plans condom promotion.

text.p: A unit of London International Group Plc plans to promote Durex Sheik condoms by bringing actress Carmen Electra, from the television series "Baywatch," to Panama City, Florida, to tutor student fun-seekers on the benefits of using a contraceptive.
Electra "will help show Spring Breakers that condoms are a normal, fun part of healthy relationships," the unit, Durex Consumer Products, said in a statement on Monday.
More than half a million students are expected to descend on Panama City for spring break, when many U.S. universities are closed for a week.

"We have always assumed students' behaviors changed during this time period," said Catherine Taylor, Durex vice-president of marketing. "We're not encouraging sex but recognizing that if people choose to have sex, they should practice safe sex."
The company plans to distribute 70,000 free samples as well as posters and T-shirts.
